$comment: GH-43 reminder-extraction battery, in the executable form GH-44 Phase 6 consumes.
The human-readable spec lives at PROJECT/1-INBOX/REMINDER-EXTRACTION-BATTERY-CORPUS.md — this
file is the machine copy the harness replays. Scenario ids match that doc (S-01..S-15).
Every scenario is a THREAD: `turns` is an ordered array of {user, text}, reusing the shape
scripts/reminder-thread-battery.js already validates. A single-message case is a one-turn
`recordedResponse` is the model answer replayed for that scenario, so a run is deterministic
and makes zero network calls. A scenario WITHOUT one is reported skipped, never passed.

scenarios.name: reported case: address block + status report + first-person commitment

turns.text:

Over time that batch got fully used up, so the system had nothing left to send.
We fixed it so the scan now covers all photos, and plants can be re-requested after enough time has passed. Emails will resume for every yard after the next deployment
i am going to deploy the changes tomorrow morning
